ether the server is configured to require an OAuth grant.\n- [List tools](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-to
ols.md): Returns the server's tools as a collection page. Each item is the MCP tool definition (`name`, `description`, `inputSchem
a`, ...).\n- [List prompts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-prompts.md): Returns the server's prompts as a c
ollection page.\n- [List resources](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-resources.md): Returns the server's reso
urces as a collection page.\n- [Read a resource](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/read-a-resource.md): Reads a sin
gle resource by URI and returns its contents.\n- [List server skills](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-server
-skills.md): Returns the Agent Skills a connected server serves over the MCP skills extension (SEP-2640), including skills it adve
rtises that MCPJam declines to load. Not paginated: the catalog is drained server-side, because duplicate detection spans the whol
e listing.\n- [Get a server skill](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/get-a-server-skill.md): Fetches one skill by U
RI and verifies it before returning a byte: the SKILL.md digest against the manifest, the fetched frontmatter against what the lis
ting advertised, and the name against the URI. Reaches skills a partial listing never mentioned. When a check fails the response c
arries a `refusal`…\n- [Read a server skill's supporting file](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/read-a-server-skil
ls-supporting-file.md): Reads one supporting file belonging to a skill, checking its byte length and digest against the skill's ow
n manifest. The manifest is the read allowlist and is re-fetched here rather than accepted from the caller, so a request cannot au
thorize its own read.\n- [Export a server snapshot](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/export/export-a-server-snapshot.md): Lis
ts tools, resources, and prompts in one call and returns a single JSON snapshot — handy for diffing a server's surface over time i
n CI.\n- [Call a tool](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/call-a-tool.md): Executes a tool on the server and returns
the MCP `CallToolResult` plus an additive `durationMs` (wall-clock time of `executeTool`). Tool-level failures (`isError: true` in
the result) are **successful calls** — the server answered; only transport/auth errors use the error envelope.\n- [Render a promp
t](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/render-a-prompt.md): Renders a prompt with arguments and returns the MCP `GetPr
omptResult` directly (`description?`, `messages`).\n- [Render an MCP App widget headlessly](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
execution/render-an-mcp-app-widget-headlessly.md): Call an MCP App tool and mount its `ui://` widget in real headless Chromium run
ning the production host bridge, then report whether it rendered, what it logged, what it was blocked from fetching, and the widge
t as an accessibility tree with addressable elements.\n- [Create a retained widget session](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
execution/create-a-retained-widget-session.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments
return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after
its idle timeout. Executes the tool and retains its App in one local Chromium context.…\n- [Read a retained widget snapshot](http
s://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/read-a-retained-widget-snapshot.md): Available only on the local Inspector that create
d the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subject, pro
ject and server and expires after its idle timeout. Returns an accessibility tree and addressable elements without replay…\n- [Act
on a retained widget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/act-on-a-retained-widget.md): Available only on the local I
nspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the o
riginal subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Runs one coordinate action with fresh project/server autho
rization.\n- [Run a retained widget step](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/run-a-retained-widget-step.md): Availabl
e only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires a verified user or API key. A sess
ion is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Runs one semantic action or assertion
, using the same locator vocabul…\n- [Close a retained widget session](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/execution/close-a-ret
ained-widget-session.md): Available only on the local Inspector that created the session; hosted deployments return 404. Requires
a verified user or API key. A session is bound to the original subject, project and server and expires after its idle timeout. Dis
poses the original owner's browser. Returns closed=false if no mat…\n- [List a suite's settings history](https://docs.mcpjam.com/a
pi-reference/eval-suites/list-a-suites-settings-history.md): One entry per committed edit to the suite's settings, newest first: w
ho made it, which STORED fields moved, the note they left, how many runs were launched against it, and the revision group that tie
s one request's writes together. Rows carry no configuration snapshots. Send a `revisionNumber` back…\n- [Attach one environment t
o a suite (atomic append)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/attach-one-environment-to-a-suite-atomic-append.md):
APPEND one project environment to the suite's attachments, if it is not already there.\n- [List a server's accounts](https://docs.
mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/list-a-servers-accounts.md): The accounts this server signs in with that you can see: you
r own personal accounts, or, on a server shared with the project, its project accounts. Another member's personal account never ap
pears. METADATA ONLY: no account response carries a token.\n- [Get a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-
accounts/get-a-server-account.md): One account, by id or name. Another member's personal account answers `404`, the same as a miss
ing one. A name two accounts share answers `409` with `details.code: \"account_name_ambiguous\"` and both ids in `details.accountI
ds`.\n- [Upload tokens to a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/upload-tokens-to-a-server-accoun
t.md): Creates the account (`201`) or replaces its token in place (`200`, same id). A well-formed account id never creates one: an
unknown id is `404`. Any other reference is a name, and a name no account has creates the account.\n- [Delete a server account](h
ttps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/delete-a-server-account.md): Deletes the account and its stored token. The to
ken's issuer is asked to revoke it where the issuer supports revocation (best effort), which also invalidates any copy of the same
token you hold.\n- [Rename a server account or make it the default](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/rename-
a-server-account-or-make-it-the-default.md): Rename the account, make it the default, or both; a rename applies first. A name anot
her account on the server uses answers `409` with `details.code: \"account_name_taken\"`.\n- [Import OAuth tokens](https://docs.mc
pjam.com/api-reference/oauth/import-oauth-tokens.md): **Deprecated.** Use `PUT /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/accounts/{
account}`. This route uploads to your default account on the server, creating an unnamed one when the server has none, and is remo
ved 90 days after the accounts API shipped. Every answer carries `Deprecation: true`, a `Sunse…\n- [List GitHub Checks repositorie
s](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/list-github-checks-repositories.md): The repositories in this organization whose pu
ll requests run an eval suite, plus the repositories the MCPJam GitHub App can reach (the choices a connect has).\n- [Run an eval
